title: Your room (phone video)
lede: Built from your phone video with our pipeline: 35.5 dB on frames it never saw. Floor and walls come from our monocular depth, so the edges are approximate.

title: Lift lobby
lede: Built from your lobby video: 23.2 dB on unseen frames, held back by the plain white walls. Its depth gives no clean floor, so you walk on a flat floor along the path the camera took.

title: Living room (ICL-NUIM dataset)
lede: The dataset room: 32.3 dB on unseen frames. Collision comes from the dataset's depth, so walls and furniture stop you exactly.
